_comment: The five pillars: the one definition both apps and the backend should read.
JSON rather than TypeScript because the consumers include two tailwind.config
files, which are CommonJS and cannot require a .ts module. shared/pillars.ts
wraps this with types for app code.
Colours follow docs/COLOR_REFERENCE.md, which is the brand reference.
NOTE: v1 (frontend/) and backend/config/pillars.py currently render civics
and wellness with these two colours SWAPPED. That is a real, user-visible
disagreement between the web and mobile apps and it predates this file --
see the Open Questions section of docs/audit-2026-08/REMEDIATION_PLAN.md.
Nothing was flipped to create this file; the divergence is pinned by
